quoter.purpose: Quotes exact-input letscash.fun trades including hook fees.

universalRouter.purpose: Executes wallet-owned letscash.fun v4 buys and sells.

permit2.purpose: Pull authorization for letscash.fun token sells through the Universal Router.

launchStakingEngine.purpose: Shared multi-token staking and snapshot-reward sink for new Sinjoh launches that explicitly require staking for airdrops. Standard holder airdrops remain the default.

operations.note: The dedicated Funding Bands observer independently compares finalized archive state with Envio history, records every threshold transition, and executes permissionless lifecycle actions. The shared routing wallet has no Funding Bands lifecycle authority.

letscashAdapterFactory.purpose: Deploys deterministic creator-scoped letscash.fun adapters without creating a token or adapter clone during this dark deployment.

letscashAdapterImplementation.purpose: Initialized implementation for immutable per-launch letscash.fun fee-recipient clones.

letscashBuybackAdapter.purpose: Converts capped WETH allocations into letscash.fun subjects through their verified native v4 pools.

letscashBuybackPriceGuard.purpose: Requires an amount-, config-, router-, and time-bound signed floor for every letscash.fun buyback.

agnosticFeeRouterImplementation.purpose: Launchpad-agnostic SinjohFeeRouter implementation for per-launch clones.

agnosticFeeRouterFactory.purpose: Deploys deterministic launchpad-agnostic fee-router clones without creating any clone during this dark deployment.

flapAdapterFactory.purpose: Deploys deterministic per-launch Sinjoh Flap adapters; no adapter clone or token was created during this dark deployment.

flapAdapterImplementation.purpose: SinjohFlapAdapter implementation, initialized and self-deployed by the adapter factory constructor.

flapBuybackAdapter.purpose: Converts WETH fee allocations into the launched Flap subject through the canonical Portal before and after graduation.

flapBuybackPriceGuard.purpose: Requires an amount- and router-bound five-minute signed floor in addition to the live Portal quote for every Flap buyback.

flapPayoutPriceGuard.purpose: Requires an amount-, router-, subject-, and output-bound signed floor plus the live Flap Portal quote when routing fees into any Flap-supported payout token.

flapV2LiquidityManager.purpose: Accumulates WETH before graduation, then buys the Flap subject, adds canonical Flap V2 liquidity, and sends the LP tokens directly to the burn address.

revenueCollector.purpose: Protocol revenue sink. Owner and initial processor are governance; renounceOwnership permanently disabled.

simpleSwapAdapter.purpose: Shared direct WETH swap and WETH-to-ETH unwrap adapter, SwapRouter02 interface. Verified by live mainnet-fork swaps through fee tiers 10000 and 3000 plus the unwrap path.

supersedes.reason: Spoke the v1 swap-router ABI; mainnet runs SwapRouter02, so every swap reverted. Discovered via the TANM test launch.

priceGuard.purpose: SinjohSharedV3TwapPriceGuard: shared TWAP guard for all launches. 15-min window, 10% max spot deviation, 7.5% max output slippage, 5-min validity, pools must be primed via prime().

airdropDistributor.purpose: Merkle airdrop distributor. Protocol fee recipient is the revenue collector.

liquidityManagerV3.purpose: Single liquidity manager (v3 + v4). DeployPonsLiquidityManager was removed as identical; one instance serves both roles on mainnet.

ponsAdapterFactory.purpose: Retained for fee collection and indexing of historical Pons v1 launches. Upstream Pons v1 new launches are disabled.

ponsAdapterImplementation.purpose: SinjohPonsV1Adapter implementation retained for historical Pons v1 launch fee collection.

ponsV2AdapterFactory.purpose: Deploys deterministic per-launch SinjohPonsV2Adapter clones and atomically escrows configured first-buy inventory for Funding Bands.

ponsV2AdapterImplementation.purpose: SinjohPonsV2Adapter implementation, initialized and self-deployed by the adapter factory constructor.

ponsV2BuybackAdapter.purpose: Singleton buyback route for pons v2 launches: converts a router's WETH bucket share into the launch token, routing by the factory's launch record at swap time - bonding curve before graduation, hooked Uniswap v4 pool after. Native-quote launches only.

ponsV2BuybackPriceGuard.purpose: Pure signed floor (SinjohPonsV2BuybackFloor, five-minute maximum validity) for pons v2 buybacks; no on-chain quote exists on either side of graduation, so the keeper's signer is the sole floor authority.

ponsV2PairBuybackAdapter.purpose: Pair-capable pons v2 buyback route: WETH into any launch's market — native or custom pair — via the pinned v3 hop, the bonding curve, or the graduated v4 pool. Supersedes ponsV2BuybackAdapter for new routes.

ponsV2PairBuybackPriceGuard.purpose: Signed-floor guard for the pair-capable pons v2 buyback route.

poolsTradeMerkleClaimFactory.purpose: Byte-identical Sinjoh deployment of Uniswap's MerkleClaimFactory (liquidity-launcher commit dd8769c), which Uniswap has not deployed on Robinhood Chain. CREATE2 through the canonical deterministic deployer with a zero salt, so the address is a pure function of the vendored artifact. Enables atomic airdrop legs on Sinjoh pools.trade LBP launches.

poolsTradeInstantAdapterFactoryCreatorFe.purpose: Deploys deterministic per-launch SinjohPoolsTradeInstantAdapter clones against the creator-fee InstantLaunchStrategy; no adapter clone or token was created during this dark deployment.

poolsTradeInstantAdapterImplementationCr.purpose: SinjohPoolsTradeInstantAdapter implementation (creator-fee variant), initialized and self-deployed by the adapter factory constructor.

poolsTradeInstantAdapterFactoryNoFee.purpose: Deploys deterministic per-launch SinjohPoolsTradeInstantAdapter clones against the no-creator-fee InstantLaunchStrategy; collect and forward are permanent no-ops on this variant by construction.

poolsTradeInstantAdapterImplementationNo.purpose: SinjohPoolsTradeInstantAdapter implementation (no-creator-fee variant), initialized and self-deployed by the adapter factory constructor.

poolsTradeLBPAdapterFactory.purpose: Deploys deterministic per-launch SinjohPoolsTradeLBPAdapter clones and keeps the one-shot subject registry the pools.trade buyback route resolves launch-configured pool keys through.

poolsTradeLBPAdapterImplementation.purpose: SinjohPoolsTradeLBPAdapter implementation, initialized and self-deployed by the adapter factory constructor.

poolsTradeBuybackAdapter.purpose: Singleton buyback route for pools.trade launches, both shapes: LBP launches resolve their recorded migrated pool key through the LBP adapter factory registry (native-quote only); everything else derives the static instant-launch key and confirms the pool exists via slot0.

poolsTradeSellAdapter.purpose: Singleton sell route for pools.trade subjects: the normalization direction (subject to WETH) LBP intake requires. Native-quote pools sell and wrap; custom-currency pools hop currency-to-WETH through the pinned SwapRouter02 with the v3 tier in routeData.

poolsTradeSubjectPriceGuard.purpose: Normalization guard for pools.trade subjects: v4 slot0 spot under a 5% haircut (v4 keeps no observations and cannot be quoted from view), composed with the shared v3 TWAP guard's quoteAtTwap for custom-currency legs. Normalization guards receive no caller data, so this quote plus the router's per-call cap and mandatory caller floor are the protection. Router configs MUST set a bounded normalization maxAmountInPerCall for the subject: unsold auction tokens can dwarf pool depth and an unbounded sync is refused by the haircut.

poolsTradeBuybackPriceGuard.purpose: Pure signed floor (SinjohPoolsTradeBuybackFloor, five-minute maximum validity) for pools.trade buybacks; no on-chain quote exists on hookless or launch-hooked v4 pools, so the keeper's signer is the sole floor authority.

ecvrfRandomness.purpose: ECVRF randomness adapter for raffles. Immutable public key verified on-chain to hash to the prover account 0x8653117338aD8120FCC15A93452526e2695F8273; key held on the prover host, separate from the attestor.

raffleFactory.purpose: SinjohRaffleRewardsFactory. Implementation initialization-locked; deploymentChainId 4663 verified on-chain.

raffleOperations.purpose: Raffle operational accounts. The attestor commits snapshot roots (keeper env SINJOH_ATTESTOR_PRIVATE_KEY); the prover holds the ECVRF secret matching the adapter's immutable public key (SINJOH_ECVRF_SECRET_KEY). Deliberately distinct: their separation is what prevents single-operator outcome grinding.

excluded.RDDT: pool 0xA541…b531 holds 3.4e16 liquidity — about 105,000x less than MSTR's — and cannot absorb any probe size inside the guard's 7.5% slippage bound. Oracle is primed and healthy; the pool needs real LP depth before RDDT can be a deliverable prize. Re-run the preflight after liquidity arrives; per-launch stock lists are immutable, so later launches can add RDDT once it certifies.

preflight.note: Seven routes passed real guarded swaps at the full 0.01 WETH probe. UI: read `certified` as the live Mystery Stock set.

rafflePriceGuards.runtimeCodeHashNote: Per-guard hashes: poolFee is an immutable embedded in the runtime code, so each tier hashes differently. Verified 2026-08-05: the three runtimes are byte-identical except the two 2-byte poolFee immutable sites; twapWindow 300, maxSpotDeviation 1000 bps, maxOutputSlippage 750 bps, validity 300s, canonical v3 factory on all three.

notDeployed.v3RouteExecutionFactory: Optional CREATE2 deployment via EIP-2470, deferred.
notDeployed.routerOwnedPons: Deliberately never deployed: duplicates DeployFeeRouter output.

dependencies.poolsTradeNotes: pools.trade is Uniswap's liquidity-launcher stack; contract sourcing and both launch shapes are documented in POOLS-TRADE-FINDINGS.md and sinjoh-launchpad-adapters/SPEC.md. Watch items: the CCA factory's protocolFeeController() is zero but mutable (the keeper logs loudly if it changes), and strategy addresses rotate with upstream versions.
dependencies.poolsTradeRaffleNotes: A raffle over a pools.trade launch must exclude every protocol contract that custodies the subject: the launch's adapter, the LiquidityLauncher, uniswapV4PositionManager, uniswapV4PoolManager, and per shape - instant: the InstantLaunchStrategy, its FeeSplitter, and (creator-fee variant) the UERC20BeneficiaryVault; LBP: the LBPStrategy and the launch's ContinuousClearingAuction. Build the list with sinjoh-keeper/src/poolstrade/predict.ts raffleExclusionsForPoolsTradeLaunch, which reads all of it off the adapter's own immutable views and returns the canonical sorted-unique form.
dependencies.ponsV2RaffleNotes: A raffle over a Pons v2 launch must exclude the launch's bonding curve (predict pre-launch via PonsV2LaunchDeployer.predictLaunchAddresses; tooling in sinjoh-keeper/src/ponsv2 and sinjoh-fee-router PonsV2LaunchPrediction) plus ponsV2LaunchFactory, uniswapV4PoolManager, ponsV2BuybackVault, ponsV2MemeHook, and the launchpad adapter. Stocks are beacon proxies: see sinjoh-raffle-rewards/ROBINHOOD_STOCKS.md.
